# MenuText

A line of text in a Menu that is not an action (D99): a build identifier, a signed-in account. It sits inside the `role="menu"` element with no role of its own, so it is in the accessibility tree as a child of the menu; it is never focused, and the arrows, Home, End and typeahead skip it, since Menu's keyboard moves only between `[data-psi-menu-item]` elements. It is never `aria-hidden`: it exists to be read. In a menu's focus mode a screen reader reaches it by browse mode or the VoiceOver cursor; to have it spoken on entering the menu, make it the menu's description.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `children` | `ReactNode` | — | yes | The line's text: information, not an action. |
| `id` | `string` | — | no | Give it an id and pass the same id to Menu's `aria-describedby` to make the line the menu's description (D99). Off by default. |

## Keyboard & assistive tech

| Keys | Behavior |
|---|---|


A line of text that is not an action (D99): inside the role="menu" element with no role of its own, never focused, skipped by the arrows, Home, End and typeahead, and never aria-hidden. In a menu's focus mode a screen reader reaches it by browse mode or the VoiceOver cursor. To have it spoken on entering the menu, give it an id and pass that id to Menu's aria-describedby; that is off by default, because a description may be spoken on every open.

## Theming

This component has no `--psi-menu-text-*` tokens — its styling binds scale tokens only, so there is nothing component-scoped to override. Theme changes reach it through the semantic tokens of its children and surroundings.



## Rules

- One accent per visual group; everything else neutral or ghost.
- danger only for actions with real consequences.
- Sizes are px numbers (24|32|40|48), never S/M/L.
- Typography tokens are --psi-text-{size}-{lineHeight}-{weight}.
- Override component tokens (--psi-{component}-*), not semantic tokens, for one-off theming.
- --psi-button-font overrides button typography across all sizes (documented D34 override; ember → mono).
- Wrap labeled form controls in Field — label association, description/error line, aria-describedby and aria-invalid come wired; don't hand-roll label+message rows.
- Field is for a control with a *visible* label. A toolbar filter control named by aria-label or placeholder takes neither a Field nor a hand-rolled label row — compare filter-toolbar (no labels) with table-pagination ("Rows per page" visible, so Field). Filters with visible labels submitted together by a Find button are filter-form: a Toolbar as="form" align="start" of Fields with one-line labels, where a field's error line is the Field's own and hangs below its control (D87, D92).
- Use Dialog for blocking modal flows — title/footer slots, dismissible gate; danger stays on the footer Buttons, one accent per group.
